raw_meta_yaml:
# This recipe uses the v1 YAML format introduced by CEP 13
# For more information see: https://prefix-dev.github.io/rattler-build/latest/reference/recipe_file/

context:
  name: adios2
  version: "2.12.1"
  sha256: 71edd8f721448311852122fca8d83ae497b43846e5bfcdfd275dc06bb7f3d0c5
  build: 6
  mpi_prefix:  ${{ 'nompi' if mpi == 'nompi' else 'mpi_' + mpi }}
  build_number: ${{ build + (100 if mpi == 'nompi' else 0) }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ornladios/ADIOS2/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}
  patches:
    - patches/disable-bmpcp-py.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: adios2-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build-libadios
        env:
          mpi: ${{ mpi }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: unix
          then:
            - ninja
            - pkg-config
            - make
            - flex
            - bison
        - cmake
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - if: mpi != "nompi"
              then:
                - ${{ mpi }}
      host:
        - python
        - numpy
        - if: mpi != "nompi"
          then:
            - ${{ mpi }}
            - mpi4py
        - libffi
        - hdf5
        - "hdf5 * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*"
        - if: unix
          then:
            - zeromq
            - libsodium
        - bzip2
        - c-blosc2
        - libcurl
        - libpng
        - openssl
        - zfp
        - if: linux and mpi != "nompi" and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then:
            - ucx
        - zlib
        - sqlite

  # C++ library: shared libs, cmake config, headers only (no Python, no CLI tools)
  - package:
      name: libadios2
    inherit: adios2-build
    build:
      # No python version in build string: libadios2 contains no Python files
      string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      skip:
        - if: python_impl == "pypy"
          then: true
        - if: win and mpi != 'nompi'
          then: true
      files:
        include:
          - if: win
            # win needs explicit include bin/*.dll
            # but not bin/bp5dbg
            then:
              - Library/bin/*.dll
              - Library/include/
              - Library/lib/
        exclude:
          # exclude bin, python
          - if: unix
            then:
              - bin/
              - lib/python*/
          - if: win
            then:
              # win (.dll is in bin)
              - Library/bin/*.exe
              - Lib/site-packages/
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libadios2', lower_bound='x.x.x', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - libadios2 * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
          - numpy
          - mpi4py
          - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            not_exists:
              - if: unix
                then:
                  - '*'
              - if: win
                then:
                  - '*.exe'
                  - bp5dbg
          include:
            - adios2.h
          lib:
            - adios2_c
            - adios2_cxx
            - if: mpi != 'nompi'
              then:
                - adios2_cxx_mpi
          files:
            not_exists:
              - lib/python*/**
              - Lib/site-packages/**
      - requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - if: unix
              then:
                - make
        files:
          source:
            - examples/
          recipe:
            - test-libadios.sh
        script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/adios2/adios2-config.cmake
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/adios2/adios2-c-targets.cmake
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/adios2/adios2-cxx-targets.cmake
              # Verify Python files are absent from this package
              - test ! -d ${SP_DIR}/adios2
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/bin/bp5dbg
              - mpi=${{ mpi }} bash test-libadios.sh
          - if: win
            then:
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\adios2\adios2-config.cmake (exit 0) else (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\adios2\adios2-c-targets.cmake (exit 0) else (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\adios2\adios2-cxx-targets.cmake (exit 0) else (exit 1)

  # Python bindings + CLI tools (bpls, bp5dbg, etc.)
  - package:
      name: adios2
    inherit:
      from: adios2-build
    build:
      string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      skip:
        - if: python_impl == "pypy"
          then: true
        - if: win and mpi != 'nompi'
          then: true
      files:
        include:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - bin/
              - lib/python*/
          - if: win
            then:
              - Library/bin/
              - Lib/site-packages/
        exclude:
          - if: win
            then:
              - Library/bin/*.dll
    requirements:
      run:
        # inherits most run dependencies from staging run_exports
        # overdepends somewhat, but no matter because pinned libadios2
        # links everything overdepended upon
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libadios2', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        # Downstream packages that host adios2 get adios2 (Python + tools) at runtime
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('adios2', lower_bound='x.x.x', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - adios2 * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - bp5dbg
            - bpls
          include:
            not_exists:
              - '*'
      - script:
          - python -c "import adios2; print(adios2.__version__)"
          - if: unix
            then:
              - bp5dbg --help
              - bpls --help

about:
  homepage: https://www.olcf.ornl.gov/center-projects/adios/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Next generation of ADIOS developed in the Exascale Computing Program
  description: |
    ADIOS2 is the latest implementation of the ADaptable Input Output System,

    lifecycle through effective research and development (R&D) activities.
  documentation: https://adios2.readthedocs.io
